prompt: In the town where the most successful American Ace of World War 2 to survive that war was born, there is a college. What was the name and percentage of the largest demographic of full and part time students attending that college in 2020?
answer:
The ace was **Major Richard I. Bong**, who was born in **Superior, Wisconsin**. The college there is the **University of Wisconsin–Superior**.

In 2020, its largest attendance category was **full-time students—about 73% of enrollment** (compared with roughly 27% part-time).
